classification.conformanceProfile: Tiled finite orthogonal object-layer-only map subset

nonClaims: Game meaning of layer names, object type strings, custom properties or topology
tile-layer, tileset, image-layer, group-layer, world-file or infinite-map support
external templates, external tilesets or file-valued property resolution
visual or artistic correctness of the map
runtime navigation, collision, pathfinding or gameplay correctness
full Tiled format support outside the bounded R1 subset
notes: Mapped from standards-first shadow profile; remains non-production until profile-v2 graduation.

formatPolicy.canonicality: source JSON semantics must equal a native Tiled TMJ export and a TMJ-to-TMX-to-TMJ cross-format round-trip
formatPolicy.formatAuthority: Tiled JSON Map Format / TMX Map Format semantics
formatPolicy.renderReadback: tmxrasterizer must produce a non-empty RGBA PNG at map width*tilewidth by height*tileheight

boundedObjectMap.claim: JSON structure stays inside the finite orthogonal object-layer-only R1 subset without external resources

canonicalSemanticIdentity.claim: canonical sorted JSON SHA-256 equals the object contract expectation

contractSchema.claim: TMJ object-map contract validates under design-2d-tiled-tmj-contract-v1

nativeCrossFormatRoundTrip.claim: Tiled TMJ→TMX→TMJ preserves the exact canonical JSON semantics

nativeRasterReadback.claim: tmxrasterizer renders a non-empty RGBA image at the contract-derived map pixel dimensions

nativeTmjRoundTrip.claim: Tiled 1.12.2 loads the source and exports semantically identical TMJ JSON
